g0.rationale: This is a silver/violet toning mask ('Silberglanz', 'Color Intense', 'Als Farbkorrektur') carrying the dye CI 60730 @17, so it is a colour-depositing product, which the charter excludes as a form. The 'Als Kur' mode (damp hair, ~2 minutes, rinse) would clear the three G0 conjuncts on its own terms. Mode scoping cannot rescue it, though: both modes apply the same pigment-bearing formula, so colour deposition is a property of the jar's chemistry, not of the use. The exclusion therefore governs the whole product. No profile is produced.
evidenceSignals: product name: 'Haarkur Silberglanz 2in1 Color Intense Kur'
directions: 'Als Farbkorrektur: ... vom Ansatz bis in die Spitzen ... ca. 5-10 Minuten einwirken lassen'
directions: 'Als Kur: ... ca. 2 Minuten einwirken lassen. Sorgfältig ausspülen.' (would clear conjuncts, but same formula)
formula fact: CI 60730 @17 (violet acid dye; colourant, not marker-eligible)
g0.notes: This is a mode-scoping seam: §2.2 tests modes against the three conjuncts, while the charter's colour-depositing exclusion is a product-form exclusion that the conjuncts do not test. Exclusion was chosen as the conservative reading (§1.1), because profiling the Kur mode would put a toning formula into mask matching. The Farbkorrektur mode also directs root application ('vom Ansatz').

tailMarker.note: Not computed: excluded at G0 before formula analysis. For the record only, Parfum @9 would be the earliest marker. CI 60730 @17 is a colourant and never sets the marker.
